t: 纳恩多夫赫尔瓦尔之围 (贝尔格莱德)开始.
dz: 奥斯曼-匈牙利战争:纳恩多夫赫尔瓦尔之围 (贝尔格莱德)开始.
de: Ottoman–Hungarian wars: The Siege of Nándorfehérvár (Belgrade) begins.

t: 在她被处决25年后 重审判决宣告异端贞德无罪.
te: A retrial verdict acquits Joan of Arc of heresy 25 years after her execution.
dz: 在她被处决25年后 重审判决宣告异端贞德无罪.
de: A retrial verdict acquits Joan of Arc of heresy 25 years after her execution.

t: 约翰·洪尼亚迪和他的部队在多瑙河上击败了奥斯曼分舰队,使他们得以增援并补给被围困的贝尔格莱德城.
te: John Hunyadi and his forces defeat the Ottoman fleet on the Danube, allowing them to reinforce and supply the besieged …
dz: 约翰·洪尼亚迪和他的部队在多瑙河上击败了奥斯曼分舰队,使他们得以增援并补给被围困的贝尔格莱德城.
de: John Hunyadi and his forces defeat the Ottoman fleet on the Danube, allowing them to reinforce and supply the besieged city of Belgrade.

t: 贝尔格莱德的包围:匈牙利王国摄政约翰·胡尼亚迪击败了奥斯曼帝国的穆罕默德二世.
te: Siege of Belgrade: John Hunyadi, Regent of the Kingdom of Hungary, defeats Mehmet II of the Ottoman Empire.
dz: 欧洲的奥斯曼战争:贝尔格莱德的包围:匈牙利王国摄政约翰·胡尼亚迪击败了奥斯曼帝国的穆罕默德二世.
de: Ottoman wars in Europe: Siege of Belgrade: John Hunyadi, Regent of the Kingdom of Hungary, defeats Mehmet II of the Ottoman Empire.

t: 格雷夫斯瓦尔德大学被建立为北欧第二古老的大学.
te: The University of Greifswald is established as the second oldest university in northern Europe.
dz: 格雷夫斯瓦尔德大学被建立为北欧第二古老的大学.
de: The University of Greifswald is established as the second oldest university in northern Europe.

t: 乌尔里希二世(Ulrich II),塞列伯爵,西里郡最后的统治者,被刺杀于贝尔格莱德.
te: Ulrich II, Count of Celje, last ruler of the County of Cilli, is assassinated in Belgrade.
dz: 乌尔里希二世(Ulrich II),塞列伯爵,西里郡最后的统治者,被刺杀于贝尔格莱德.
de: Ulrich II, Count of Celje, last ruler of the County of Cilli, is assassinated in Belgrade.

t: 两次震级为 7.2 级的地震中的第一场袭击了意大利，造成了极大的破坏并导致 70,000 多人…
te: The first of two earthquakes measuring Mw 7.2 strikes Italy, causing extreme destruction and killing upwards of 70,000 …
dz: 两次震级为 7.2 级的地震中的第一场袭击了意大利，造成了极大的破坏并导致 70,000 多人死亡。
de: The first of two earthquakes measuring Mw 7.2 strikes Italy, causing extreme destruction and killing upwards of 70,000 people.
